scope.purpose: License and source provenance for the Basalt literal-port implementation and its checked-in oracle/fixture generators.
scope.algorithm_source_policy: The audited tree contains no copied upstream source subtree. Based on the current source review, Rust modules are classified as clean-room translations or contract adapters and C++/scripts as newly written diagnostic/fixture code that compiles against pinned dependencies; this classification is not a legal determination or a line-by-line authorship proof.
scope.hash_basis: Repository working-tree bytes as present on 2026-08-30; line endings are not normalized by the verifier.
scope.production_source_hash_policy: Every Rust source under pipelines/basalt/src is listed in port_files with a SHA-256 binding.

vcpkg_resolution.source_ref_policy: Registry versions are resolved to immutable upstream tag commits above; the vcpkg baseline and overlay port commit remain the reproducible package-resolution anchors.

comparison_report.legacy_field_note: The legacy comparator widens raw_residual; covariance and sqrt acceptance is taken from the run8/run3 captures below.

schedule.covariance: Eigen aliased general GEMM chain with packet body, scalar ninth-row tail, and separate packet-compatible assignment += schedule
schedule.ldlt: Pivoted lower LDLT with packet FMA A21 update and Eigen panel-order forward solve
schedule.sqrt: Promoted double sqrt/division cast back to f32 at D^-1/2 boundary

factor_local_gate.frame3_to_frame4: covariance, sqrt-information, raw residual, Jacobian, W*r, W*J, J^T J, and J^T r all 0 mismatches

80.first_divergence: frame 8 / iteration 4: native R, Rust A

release.legal_uncertainty: This is a provenance record, not legal advice. The manifest records source licenses and notice handling for the audited paths; a release owner should obtain legal review for any binary bundling, transitive vcpkg package, or future source copy.
